answer: Sybil resistance comes from linking equivocation evidence across bonded identities: if k coordinated keys sign conflicting histories, correlated penalties grow as O(k^2), not merely as per-key fines. Detection slashes escrow and applies asymmetric depreciation, so maintaining a swarm multiplies capital loss exponentially with its size; splitting stake among ivory, copper, and onyx aliases cannot dilute shared evidence or restore forfeited collateral.
